questions.question: When was metformin first prescribed, and what was the initial dose and timing?
What other medications were the patient taking before starting metformin, and were any adjusted or discontinued?
Has the patient reported stomach upset or gastrointestinal side effects with metformin previously, and how was it managed?
Was any baseline renal function testing performed before initiating metformin?
Was diabetes education or dietary counseling provided at the time of metformin initiation?
Are there documented instructions for managing mild GI side effects (e.g., dose titration, food timing) with this metformin start?
